measurement.contact: First World interval with nonzero transmitted grip force or actual torso impulse; acquisition/proximity alone is not contact.
measurement.clock: Speed before that force-bearing interval to actual boundary at +0.2/+0.4/+0.8 s, 20 Hz. No terminal extension or clamped samples.
measurement.censoring: Native time-limit/sideline endpoints remain censored, not tackles. Later sample counts reflect survival.
measurement.channels: Actual carrier velocity changes across native impulse execution; ground from StepReport. Torso scalar impulse includes real collisions only.
measurement.ablation: acquire-finish deletes brace before World, retaining earlier standing-reach acquisition and no reel. Diagnostic only.

closureTapes.use: Mirrored losing native decision/body/grip tapes plus unchanged diving control; replay with the wrap-binding-refinement operator. No imposed recorded slip or compression.

finish_to_reach-finish.advanceCaveat: Grip acquisition happens earlier in reach arms; advanceAfterGrip clocks differ. Do not interpret as paired NFL YAC.
